title: East Asian Graphics Archive
alt: Poster from the East Asian Graphics Archive
note: Archive of Korean, Japanese and Chinese posters and packaging. Go-to for reference hunting on design drafts. Found via @bingsome on X.

title: Tommy Trinh, personal site
note: Living-status homepage: live age counter, Working / Listening / Reading rows, j/k and t keyboard shortcuts, and a Documenting feed pulled from Are.na.

title: Dara Miao, personal site
note: Golf-scorecard section that opens on scroll, a GitHub contribution graph, dated storytelling cards, and an 'Are you an agent?' llms.txt link.

title: Gradient study, warm to deep violet
alt: Orange to violet gradient with a soft overlapping circle
note: Two-stop gradients still carry a poster if the hue travel is long enough.

title: Type specimen with a very long ascender
alt: Dark navy panel with a bright blue gradient and a rule
note: Specimen pages that show one glyph at display size beat full alphabet grids.

title: Motion frames, 12fps sprite sheet
alt: Acid green to black gradient square
note: Stepped easing reads as intentional when the frame count is low and constant.

title: Editorial grid, asymmetric column break
alt: Cream panel with a red gradient wash
note: The break lands on the third column, which keeps the rag from squaring off.

title: Color field, violet into pink
note: Saved for the midpoint — it stays saturated instead of going muddy.

title: Interface detail, focus ring treatment
alt: Near-black panel with a mint green gradient
note: Focus rings offset by 3px outside the control read much better on dark UI.
